title: codemother-crosses-a-boat-through-the-harbor-door-as-herself
intention: Codemother's shim answers a `cross` verb that fires the harbor door with actor codemother, so a crossing she admits carries her name in the record of truth.
why: Codemother owns the care of the code on paper (2026-09-06) but every crossing record still says cleared by 'CC' or 'cc' — she has no hand. The lived symptom: her review can refuse nothing and admit nothing; the ownership transfer is a sentence in a memory file.
how: Item 1 of the idea. A `cross <ticket-id> <target>` verb in codemother's shim reaches the harbor door over the bus (harbor_master is a machine under the cairn device — no cross-device import) and requests the clearance with actor='codemother'; the door's existing checks (chart claim, intent/sorted berths, standing seal) run unchanged. The record's clearance_gate then reads cleared by 'codemother'. Items 2 (inference_domain's line) and 3 (her judgment — a design session) are cast separately; this is plumbing.
falsifier: DONE when: (1) `cairn codemother cross <ticket> <target>` against a fixture history produces a crossing record whose clearance_gate says cleared by 'codemother' and whose actor field is codemother; (2) the door's refusals (unproven, unclaimed) still refuse when she fires them — proof exercises one refusal; (3) grep of cairn/devices/codemother for 'harbor_master' imports returns nothing (bus only). WRONG INTENT if the door needs a second signature (Akien) for her crossings — then this is a co-sign, and the ticket says so.
traces_to: Law 6 — an owner gates writes through her own gate; an owner with no gate is paper. Memory codemother-owns-the-care-of-the-code (2026-09-06): owner of all code things; the crossing is the write she must gate.
watchme: none, because every crossing record already carries its actor (cairn/tools/base/transitions.py emit, journal_extra.actor) — the count of records with actor codemother is a grep over history.json files and is the measure of whether she is used

Verbatim: CODEMOTHER'S FIRST CROSSING, MADE BY HER, ON THE TICKET THAT GAVE HER THE HAND. Her shim answers a 'cross' verb that fires the harbor door over the bus with actor='codemother' -- the bus stamps the sender, so the asker cannot choose it -- and the record of truth now reads "cleared by 'codemother'" instead of 'CC'. Build gate clean over 33 sieves with 34 checks proved; exit gate clean, the claiming chart answered. Three falsifier teeth: an accepted crossing whose fixture history reads actor=codemother; an unproven boat still REFUSED through her carrying the door's own reason (a hand that can only say yes is not a gate); and zero harbor_master imports under her device, bus only. THE GATE THAT ALMOST STOPPED HER WAS HER OWN: this charter carried gated_by ['CC'], so the first boat she could not cross was her own component. Reported to Akien as a spec choice rather than fixed on my read; he ruled in six words -- 'her gate should admit her, fix it' -- recorded at CairnCommons/decisions/2026-09-09-codemothers-own-gate-admits-her.json. gated_by is now ['codemother','CC']. FOUR BUGS THE VOYAGE UNCOVERED AND FIXED under bounds ruling 2026-09-09-a-bug-the-voyage-uncovers-is-fixed-by-that-voyage: reach() could not find a shim berthed under a machine tree; a posting shim handler was handed its own envelope forever because the delivery receipt is written after deliver() returns; read_history swallowed a non-list silently; and the largest, found by the pre-commit ladder rather than by me -- chain.grammar.ticket_path globbed '*-<claim>.json' unanchored, so any English word ENDING a ticket slug resolved to that ticket, and reason_has_referent (the floor built to stop hollow exemptions) splits prose into words and offered each one. 'none, because we talked about it' passed on 'it'. Measured: 270 filed tickets, ZERO carry the id as a suffix, so the tail match never once served a real lookup; 364 exemption reasons, 321 passed before and 177 now -- the floor was certifying plausible sentences at 71%, and no proof anywhere judged it directly. It has teeth of its own now, both channels hand-falsified. Tightening it then exposed a THIRD path convention nobody had written down: the ruling gate spells what_dies/what_conforms relative to the roots PARENT, so a reason citing the very decision that settled it redded; 9 of the 196 reds were that. 196 -> 187, with a tooth proving a roots-parent path to nothing still fails.
